map.基于Lown分级系统对室性心律失常进行危险分级，指导临床干预决策: Risk-grade ventricular arrhythmias by the Lown system, guiding clinical intervention
map.极高危，可诱发室颤: Very high risk, can trigger VF
map.监测心功能，评估心律失常性心肌病: Monitor cardiac function, assess arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy
map.心律失常性心肌病风险高，考虑导管消融: High arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy risk, consider catheter ablation
map.提示：Lown分级主要用于急性心梗后室早评估，对非缺血性室早的预测价值有限。室早: Note: Lown grading is mainly for post-MI PVCs; limited predictive value for non-ischemic PVCs. PVC burden >15% or with reduced cardiac function should assess ablation. VT lasting >30s is sustained VT, needs urgent care. For clinical reference only.
map.Lown 分级参考：室早按频发、多形、连发、成串（室速）分级，越高心律失常风险越: Lown reference: PVCs graded by frequency, polymorphic, paired, runs (VT); higher means more risk, but modern emphasis is on total burden and underlying heart disease.
map.室早负荷量化：24h 室早占心搏: PVC burden quantification: 24h PVCs as fraction of total beats
map.，>10%–15% 长期可致心动过速性心肌病，考虑射频或药物。: , >10%-15% long-term can cause tachycardiomyopathy, consider RF ablation or drugs.
map.非持续性室速识别：连续 ≥3 个室早、持续 <30s，合并结构性心脏病或射血分数: Non-sustained VT recognition: >=3 consecutive PVCs, lasting <30s; with structural heart disease or low EF prognosis is poor, needs further ICD evaluation.
map.输入：24h 总心搏 98,000、室早 12,000（占 12.2%）、多形、: Input: 24h total beats 98,000, PVCs 12,000 (12.2%), polymorphic, 80 couplets, 3 non-sustained VT runs (longest 4 beats). Output: PVC burden 12.2% (>10% high), Lown approx IVb, note with structural disease assess cardiomyopathy risk, advice cardiology follow-up + echo. Note: grading for reference, combine with symptoms and EF.
map.不一定。无结构性心脏病、EF 正常者即便室早多也多良性；但若负荷 >10%–15: Not necessarily. No structural disease, normal EF, even many PVCs are mostly benign; but burden >10%-15% or with dizziness/syncope may cause tachycardiomyopathy or signal underlying disease, needs echo and etiology.
map.Lown 分级偏急性心梗背景，现代更强调总负荷、形态（单/多形）、是否成对/连发: Lown grading leans on acute-MI context; modern emphasis is total burden, morphology (mono/polymorphic), paired/runs, and underlying disease and EF. Holter's value is quantifying burden and capturing symptom-correlated arrhythmia, not just the grade letter.
map.症状明显、负荷高致心肌病风险、或合并结构性心脏病/低 EF 的非持续室速，考虑药: Clear symptoms, high burden causing cardiomyopathy risk, or non-sustained VT with structural disease/low EF consider drugs or RF ablation; asymptomatic with normal function mostly observe. Decided by cardiology by overall risk.
map.动态心电图(24h Holter)室早室速Lown分级器，根据室性早搏频率、形态: Holter (24h) PVC/VT Lown grader - risk-grades by PVC frequency, morphology, couplets, VT and R-on-T phenomenon.
map.依据国际/中国心血管指南与公开公式标准（ESC/ACC/AHA 等）逐项计算: Calculations follow international/Chinese cardiovascular guidelines and published formulas (ESC/ACC/AHA, etc.)
map.实时输出风险分层、关键截断值与分级: Outputs risk stratification, key thresholds and grading in real time
map.输入数值可复核，过程透明可追溯: Inputs are verifiable, the process is transparent and traceable
map.数据本地处理，不上传服务器: Data processed locally, not uploaded to server
